sourcePolicy: All questions in this pack are Ready2Go original draft practice items unless an individual record states otherwise. No official JAMB past-question corpus is included. Human subject-matter and answer-key review is required before public release.

questions.question: Why is a warm-up performed before vigorous exercise?

options.C: To stop the heart from beating faster
options.D: To prepare the body gradually for activity

questions.explanation: A warm-up raises activity gradually and prepares movement.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Aerobic exercise relies substantially on which process?
questions.explanation: Aerobic metabolism uses oxygen to support sustained activity.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Why is drinking water important during physical activity?

options.B: It helps replace fluid lost through sweating
options.C: It removes the need for rest

questions.explanation: Hydration supports temperature regulation and circulation.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: BMI is calculated using weight divided by what?
questions.explanation: BMI equals mass in kilograms divided by height in metres squared.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: For an unresponsive person who is not breathing normally, what is the priority?

options.D: Call emergency help and start CPR if trained

questions.explanation: Rapid emergency response and CPR are priorities.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which nutrient is especially important for bone mineralisation?
questions.explanation: Calcium is important for bone structure.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: In a team sport, sportsmanship means what?
questions.explanation: Sportsmanship includes fair play and respect.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Flexibility refers to the ability to do what?

options.A: Move joints through an appropriate range of motion

questions.explanation: Flexibility concerns range of motion at joints.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Cardiorespiratory endurance concerns the ability of which systems to support sustained activity?
questions.explanation: Endurance depends on oxygen delivery and use during prolonged activity.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Handwashing helps reduce the spread of what?
questions.explanation: Hand hygiene lowers transfer of pathogens.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: The acronym RICE has commonly referred to rest, ice, compression and what?
questions.explanation: RICE is a traditional basic approach for some acute soft-tissue injuries; serious injuries need assessment.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: The pulse is a measure related to what?
questions.explanation: Pulse rate reflects the frequency of arterial pressure waves from heartbeats.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which approach is safest when beginning a new fitness programme?

options.A: Immediately train at maximum intensity every day
options.D: Progress gradually and consider current health

questions.explanation: Gradual progression helps reduce overload and injury risk.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Regular physical activity can support wellbeing by contributing to what?
questions.explanation: Activity can support wellbeing but is not a guaranteed cure.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Immunisation helps protect people by doing what?

options.B: Preparing the immune system to recognise a pathogen
options.C: Removing all microorganisms from the environment

questions.explanation: Vaccines train immune responses and reduce disease risk.
